owner_names: Dylan G. Haggart; Fivespan Partners, LP; Fivespan Partners GP, LLC
footnote_text: In addition to Dylan G. Haggart ("Mr. Haggart"), this Form 4 is being filed jointly by Fivespan Partners, LP, a Delaware limited partnership ("Fivespan") and Fivespan Partners GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Fivespan GP," and, together with Mr. Haggart and Fivespan, the "Reporting Persons"), each of whom has the same business address as Mr. Haggart and may be deemed to be the beneficial owner of certain of the securities reported on this Form 4 (the "Subject Securities") for purposes of Rule 16a-1(a) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. Each of the Reporting Persons disclaims any beneficial ownership of any of the Subject Securities, except to the extent of any pecuniary interest therein. || Includes securities directly owned by Fivespan Partners Fund, Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company (the "Fivespan Fund"). The principal business of Fivespan, Fivespan Fund and Fivespan GP is investment management. Fivespan serves as investment manager to Fivespan Fund. Fivespan GP serves as the general partner of Fivespan. The principal business of Mr. Haggart is to serve as the co-founder, managing partner and chief investment officer of Fivespan, and the managing member of Fivespan GP. || Mr. Haggart is a member of the board of directors of the Issuer of the Subject Securities, and as a result, Fivespan and Fivespan GP may be a director by deputization for purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
